gloss: relying on divine help; prayer as a last resort

definitions.gloss: relying on divine help; praying to God as a last resort
definitions.explanation: Turning to the gods or to prayer when all other options have been exhausted. Implies a desperate or helpless situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{神頼|かみだの}み⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: All we can do now is pray.
Praying before an exam won't do any good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{神頼|かみだの}み⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦していて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Nothing will change if you just pray without making any effort.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧ (god) + {頼|たの}み (reliance, request). Rendaku changes た⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧ to だ⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧.

USAGE:
Often used in the expression {神頼|かみだの}み⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧ (there's nothing left but to pray). Carries a nuance of desperation — the speaker has tried everything else and has no remaining options. Can also be used critically, to suggest someone is being lazy or passive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神頼|かみだの}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pray to the gods)
- {神頼|かみだの}み⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧ (praying is all that's left)
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神頼|かみだの}み (a last-ditch prayer)
